description: Java class implementing client credentials with SSL context initialization, handling PEM certificates and private keys for TLS connections.

classes.name: CertPemCredentials
classes.description: Represents PEM-based SSL credentials with methods to initialize SSL context and manage certificates and keys.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the credentials type, specifically CERT_PEM.

methods.name: initSslContext
methods.description: Initializes and returns an SSL context using provided certificates and private keys.

methods.name: createAndInitTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Creates and initializes a TrustManagerFactory with CA certificates.

methods.name: createAndInitKeyManagerFactory
methods.description: Creates and initializes a KeyManagerFactory with client certificates and private key.

methods.name: loadKeyStore
methods.description: Loads certificates and private key into a KeyStore.
